description: Request body for a SODA3 `/query` request.

query.description: A SoQL query string (SELECT/WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET/HAVING). Defaults to `SELECT *`.
query.example: SELECT region, count(*) AS quake_count WHERE magnitude > 3.0 GROUP BY region ORDER BY quake_count DESC

parameters.description: Named parameters required by parameterized views.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Default is 600 (10 minutes).

includeSystem.description: Whether to include system columns (`:id`, `:created_at`, `:updated_at`). Defaults to true.

includeSynthetic.description: Whether to include computed/synthetic columns not explicitly requested. Defaults to true.
